_comment: Raw DShield-firewall events (Phase I3). The sensor's DShield client writes localdshield.log as batched JSON — one line per submission: {"type":"firewall","logs":[{time,flags,sip,dip,proto,sport,dport,version},...],"authheader":...}. An Elastic Agent policy pulls each line to the `prism.dshield.firewall` ingest pipeline, which json-parses it, DROPS the authheader (DShield API credential — never stored), and reroutes here. One ES doc per submission batch; the per-connection events live in the `logs` nested array (the ingest pipeline cannot fan an array into separate docs). The per-source rollup (`rollup firewall-ips`) aggregates across the nested events. Created by `init-indexes --source dshield --layer firewall` so sip/dip get `ip` type before the agent writes. dynamic:true so the agent's host.*/agent.*/ecs.* metadata auto-maps. nested_objects.limit raised so a large flush doesn't get rejected.
